body.p: Code templates are code fragments that you can quickly insert at the current editing position. includes a set of built-in code templates for CSS, LESS, Schematron, XSL, XQuery, JSON, HTML, and XML Schema document types. You can also define your own code templates for any type of file and share them with others.

Code templates are displayed with a symbol in the content completion list (Enter in Author mode or in Text mode). Also, in Text mode, you can press to see a complete list of the available code templates. To insert a code template at the cursor position, select it from the content completion list or type its code and press Enter. If a shortcut key has been assigned to the code template, you can also use that shortcut to insert it.

section.title: How to Create Code Templates
section.p:
To create a code template, follow these steps:
and go to Editor Content Completion Code Templates .
Click New to open the code template configuration dialog box.You can use one of the existing code templates as a starting point by selecting it and clicking Duplicate.
Code Template Configuration Dialog Box
Configure your template using the fields in the code template configuration dialog box:
Name - The name of the code template.
Associate with - You can choose whether the code template is associated with a specific type of editor or with all editor types.
Click OK to save the new code template.
Result: Your code template can now be selected using the Content Completion Assistant (Enter in Author mode or in Text mode). The code templates are displayed with a symbol.

section.title: How to Share Code Templates
section.p: There are several easy ways to share all of your code templates with other members of your team:

ol.li: and go to Editor Templates Code Templates .
Click the Export button to export all of your code templates into an XML file.
Share the XML file with other members of your team.

li.p: Instruct them to , go to Editor Templates Code Templates , click the Import button, and select the file you sent them.
Result: The code templates will now be available in their content completion list.

u.b: Share a Project that Includes the Code Templates

ol.li: and go to Editor Templates Code Templates .
Select Project Options at the bottom of the dialog box. This stores the preferences in the project file (.xpr).

li.p: Share the project file with the other members of your team. For example, you can commit it to your version control system and have them update their working copy.
Result: When they open the updated project file in their Project viewProject Explorer view, the code templates will be available in their content completion list.

u.b: Share a Folder of Code Template Files

section.p: In the Editor Content Completion Code Templates preferences page, the Additional code templates folder option loads code templates stored in a folder, with one XML file for each template. Its default value is ${pd}/codeTemplates, a folder inside the project directory, so you can commit that folder to your version control system and other members of your team will get the templates when they update their working copy.

u.b: Contribute Code Templates from a Framework

section.p: If the code templates are specific to a document type, you can store them in the framework directory. They are then proposed for all documents associated with that framework (document type), and you can share the entire framework with other members of your team without requiring them to import anything.

body.note: It is also possible to configure certain actions that function similarly to code templates and add them to the content completion list for a particular framework. You could then share the whole framework with other members of your team.
